Repealing
executive issuances, orders, rules and
regulations or parts thereof inconsistent with the provisions of this Executive Order are
hereby repealed or modified accordingly.
SECTION 3. Effectivity.
Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 27ti(!ay of
